findings.description: Plaintext AWS access_key and secret_key are embedded directly in the function's environment variables. These credentials are committed to source control and are exposed to anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration or GetFunction access, and Lambda environment variables are visible in the AWS console/API.

The function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which has reached end of life and no longer receives security patches. Deploying on an unsupported runtime exposes the function to known, unpatched vulnerabilities in the Node.js runtime and bundled libraries.
